findings.item: Prior unsupported 500ms lifecycle deadline / false acceptance
findings.evidence: member-chat-visible-proof.mjs captures the existing 10,000ms foreground wait budget; each lifecycle check sets one Date.now deadline before target lookup, computes remaining time after Target.getTargets returns, shares that deadline across initial sample and repair, requires frame progress, and refuses hidden/unfocused/zero-opacity-mounted transcript states.

findings.item: Late frame callback cannot turn a timed-out sample into frame progress
findings.verdict: ADDRESSED in implementation; regression evidence is partial
findings.evidence: The evaluator settles once, clears/cancels the frame on timeout, and increments the counter only in the winning frame callback. The test invokes a pending callback after timeout and confirms the frame counter is unchanged. However the timeout test forces setTimeout to queue a microtask; no test demonstrates expiry after a realistic delayed CDP transit against the shared deadline.

findings.item: Identity, focus, opacity, restoration, pre-send refusal, failure persistence
findings.evidence: Guard pins the original unique page target and expected web URL, uses only trusted reopen/activate on that target, checks before send and around captures, and requires visible+focused+frame progress and positive opacity when mounted. Existing proof tests preserve failed verdict despite post-failure capture evidence.

findings.item: Verdict A — source/spec and live proof
findings.evidence: Source contract is coherent, but actual native panel foreground/physical visibility and user-path acceptance were not exercised in a live browser. Do not claim product PASS.
